title: High-Risk Memories? Comparative audit of the representation of Second World War atrocities in Ukraine by generative AI applications

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy, hallucination rates, and frequency of moralizing statements in generative AI outputs across equivalent zero-shot prompts translated into English, Ukrainian, and Russian.

Auditing model responses to compare fact-based accuracy and the presence of normative, moralizing statements regarding historical WWII mass atrocities committed against specific population groups (Jews, Poles, and Ukrainians).
